entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2102601381497162240: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.8071 +/- 0.0233 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 128.09 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 14.689, 10.432 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.26 +/- 0.054 solar radii from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1646 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract). Mass 0.24 +/- 0.064 solar masses from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1646 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract). Temperature 3299 +/- 36.22 K from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1646 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,299 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc180. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,299 K and log g 4.99 (u1 0.153, u2 0.460): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
